Who We Are

A family name behind every celebration we craft

Matrushree Event Management is run by Mr. Chetan, planning and decorating weddings, naming ceremonies, housewarmings and family milestones for clients across Karnataka. Every stage, mandap and entrance you see in our gallery was designed and executed by our own team — not stock photography.

From the first phone call to the last flower petal swept off the stage, we stay hands-on: one point of contact, transparent costing, and décor built around what your family actually wants.
